verdict.rationale: A direct probe found a downloadable OpenAPI document at https://www.librechat.ai/openapi.json (HTTP 200, containing an "openapi" key), which meets the core of the story. The README also describes a programmatic Agent Management API (beta) that such a spec would plausibly cover. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing the spec and which endpoints it covers, confirmation that it covers the Agent Management API rather than only the docs site, and independent or hands-on corroboration of its completeness (the API is labeled beta).
